grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: Week 8 Listening: Past, Plans, and a Small Test
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。先听录音（或读转录稿），然后完成8道题。题目有选择题和填空题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解释为中文。
transcript:
A: Hi, Mei. Were you at the library yesterday?
B: Yes, I was. I was there because I needed a book.
A: Was it busy?
B: No, it wasn't. It was very quiet.
A: Good. What are you going to do this weekend?
B: I'm going to visit my sister. She was sick last week.
A: Oh, I'm sorry. Is she better now?
B: Yes, she is. She was tired, but now she is fine.
A: Great. Are you going to take the bus?
B: No, I'm going to drive. The bus was slow last time.
A: OK. And Tom? Is he going to come?
B: No, he isn't. He has a football match on Saturday.
A: I see. Well, have a good weekend!
B: Thanks! You too.

questions.evidence: A: Hi, Mei. Were you at the library yesterday? B: Yes, I was.

questions.explanation: A 问 'Was it busy?'，B 回答 'No, it wasn't. It was very quiet.'，所以图书馆很安静。
questions.evidence: A: Was it busy? B: No, it wasn't. It was very quiet.

grammar.title: 过去时 was/were 与 be going to 表计划
grammar.explanation: was/were 是 am/is/are 的过去式，表示过去的状态。I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were。be going to 表示计划或打算做某事，后面接动词原形。because 表示原因，后面接句子。
grammar.example: She was tired, but now she is fine. / I'm going to visit my sister.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：I ______ at home yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，过去时用 was。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：They ______ happy last week.
questions.explanation: 主语是 They，过去时用 were。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：She ______ going to cook dinner tonight.
questions.explanation: 主语是 She，be going to 用 is。
questions.evidence: She is going to cook dinner tonight.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的词填空：I stayed home ______ I was tired.
questions.explanation: because 表示原因，后面接原因。
questions.evidence: I stayed home because I was tired.
